# thenightera

> thenightera is a global design studio based in Indore, India. It works with brands worldwide across brand identity, social media, web development, and public relations.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.thenightera.tech/): Overview of thenightera, capabilities, work, process, and contact options.
- [About](https://www.thenightera.tech/about): Company background, founder, location, and operating approach.
- [Services](https://www.thenightera.tech/services): Social media, web development, PR, brand identity, and related services.
- [Portfolio](https://www.thenightera.tech/portfolio): Selected creative, social, video, and brand work.
- [Pricing](https://www.thenightera.tech/pricing): Current service packages and commercial starting points.
- [Client reviews](https://www.thenightera.tech/testimonials): Attributed client experiences.
- [FAQ](https://www.thenightera.tech/faq): Direct answers about services, process, pricing, and timelines.
- [Contact](https://www.thenightera.tech/contact): Consultation and enquiry options.
- [Calma](https://www.thenightera.tech/calma): restaurant feedback-intelligence product that helps teams understand guest comments and recurring themes.
- [Social media marketing](https://www.thenightera.tech/social-media-marketing): Strategy, production, publishing, and reporting.
- [Web development](https://www.thenightera.tech/web-development): Mobile-first, conversion-focused websites.
- [Public relations](https://www.thenightera.tech/pr-agency): Positioning, media materials, and outreach planning.
- [Branding](https://www.thenightera.tech/branding-agency): Positioning, visual identity, voice, and brand systems.
- [Case studies](https://www.thenightera.tech/case-studies): Client briefs, delivered work, and reported outcomes.
